title: RuntimeDecision
description: PROPOSED, NOT ADMITTED. Separates what the grounds establish (epistemic_status), what the runtime did (execution_disposition), and why it did it (decision_basis). schemas/draft/runtime-evaluation.schema.json collapses all three into a single `verdict` field; that collapse is the defect this schema exists to correct. The cross-field constraints in `allOf` are the contract, not documentation: a decision violating one is invalid, not merely discouraged. See adr/ADR-013.md. schemas/draft is NOT modified by this proposal.

reason_code.description: Stable machine-readable reason. Registry in docs/contracts/WARRANT-CONTRACT-v0.1.md.

control_policy_reason_code.$comment: Reason codes that justify a CONTROL_REQUIREMENT basis.

epistemic_status.description: What the admitted grounds establish about the claim. ESTABLISHED: the grounds establish it, with durability carried by warranty_grade_observed rather than by this field. REFUTED: the grounds establish its negation. UNRESOLVED: the grounds do not settle it, or it was never validly evaluated. CONTRADICTED: the admitted ground set is inconsistent, which is a finding about the grounds rather than a refutation of the proposition. UNRESOLVED is NOT a weak REFUTED; conflating them is the failure this field exists to prevent (I-03).

execution_disposition.description: What the runtime did. Independent of epistemic_status: a BLOCK may accompany UNRESOLVED (fail closed) or REFUTED (grounds establish the negation), and those are not the same event.

decision_basis.description: Why the runtime did it. SUBSTANTIVE: the admitted grounds determine a positive, negative, or contradictory epistemic result. PRECAUTIONARY: the grounds remain unresolved and the runtime fails closed. PROCEDURAL: the claim could not be validly evaluated because an artifact, binding, version, availability, or integrity precondition failed. CONTROL_REQUIREMENT: the claim WAS validly evaluated, but the admitted control requires a particular assurance grade, human role, escalation path, or non-automatic decision mode. Only SUBSTANTIVE is a finding about the world; PRECAUTIONARY, PROCEDURAL and CONTROL_REQUIREMENT are never findings that the proposition is false.

reason_codes.description: Sorted lexicographically, deterministic. At least one is always present, including on ALLOW.

missing_ground_ids.description: Level 1: stable proposition or atom identifiers as emitted by the kernel. Present whenever the kernel reported unverified grounds, INCLUDING when the outcome is ALLOW.

missing_ground_anchors.description: Level 2: human-review references linking each missing proposition to its source and admission context. Enrichment is the OIC adapter's job, never the kernel's. An empty list means enrichment has not run; it does not mean there are no missing grounds.

warrant_artifact_id.description: The warrant this decision rests on, or null when no usable warrant existed. Null with ALLOW is forbidden by the constraints below.

warrant_state.description: Why the warrant was or was not usable. MISBOUND covers epoch, formula, profile, source-version, and admission-version mismatch: the artifact is well formed but describes a different world, a different proposition, or a different kernel's semantics. NOT_REQUIRED applies only when the control's warrant_requirement.mode is not_required or not_applicable, and never waives authority, admission, evidence, or version checks.

warranty_grade_observed.description: Grade the warrant actually carried. Null only when no warrant was evaluated.

warranty_grade_required.description: Minimum grade the control's warrant_requirement declares. Null only when warrant_requirement.mode is not_required or not_applicable. There is no default: an absent requirement is a contract error, not a permissive one.

on_unknown_applied.description: The envelope's on_unknown policy, set ONLY when it was the reason for the outcome, otherwise null. `deny` means an operational fail-closed block and is never evidence that the proposition is false; the constraints below forbid pairing it with SUBSTANTIVE or ALLOW.

replay_reference.description: How to replay this decision to its exact control, admission, sources, warrant, inputs, and versions (I-15). REQUIRED and non-empty on EVERY decision including failures: an evaluation that blocked because no warrant existed must still be replayable, or the failure cannot be audited.

allOf.$comment: Rule 1. ALLOW requires ESTABLISHED, SUBSTANTIVE, a USABLE warrant, a non-null warrant id, and no on_unknown fallback.
Rule 2. UNRESOLVED can neither ALLOW nor claim a substantive finding.
Rule 4. CONTRADICTED blocks, substantively. A finding about the ground set, not a refutation of the proposition.
Rule 5. Any non-USABLE warrant state cannot ALLOW.
Rule 6. A non-null on_unknown fallback cannot ALLOW and cannot be substantive.
Rule 7. CONTROL_REQUIREMENT must carry a control-policy reason code, and never silently rewrites the epistemic status: the claim was validly evaluated, so ESTABLISHED stays ESTABLISHED.
